newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo says unaffected by strike.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo says unaffected by strike.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said Monday's two-hour strike by crew and handling staff did not hit airfreight operations.
The 35 cancelled flights and 46 delayed by the industrial action were largely domestic flights and some to France, Italy and Austria, Lufthansa Cargo spokesman Dietrich Seidl said.
"There were was no impact for us. We carry very little freight on these flights since most is transported by truck within Germany and from these countries," he noted.
Freighter flights were not affected by the strike since the 170 freighter aircraft pilots are employed by Lufthansa Cargo AG and not parent company Deutsche Lufthansa AG, Seidl said.
"Our pilots have their own contracts with us and the wage contract with them is still valid until next year," Seidl stated.
The only impact on ground handling were slight delays at Hamburg Airport, he noted. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
